items.title: Chile copper output nears 23-year low as mines struggle
items.summary: Ageing deposits, uneven mine performance and dependence on imported sulfuric acid complicate Chile's copper recovery.

items.title: Lilly pens another deal, inking up to $5.9B oncology pact with Stipple
items.summary: A licensing pact with Stipple Bio was one of two announced by Eli Lilly on Monday, after the up to $1.5 billion buyout of blood cancer-focused Calytrix Bio.

items.title: Less than a year into the job, Everett Cunningham steps down as Quanterix CEO
items.summary: Quanterix is on the lookout for a new chief executive once again as Everett Cunningham, who only started the top job back in January, hits the exit.

items.title: Clene Nanomedicine uses CRO Veristat’s biostatistics platform for FDA submission
items.summary: Clinical research organization Veristat has partnered with Clene Nanomedicine to accelerate data outputs for its FDA application for its ALS drug.

items.title: Pfizer enters in vivo CAR-T space via 3-program, $2.6B deal with China’s Starna
items.summary: Pfizer has decided to join the in vivo CAR-T race, penning a $2.6 billion deal for three preclinical candidates from China’s Starna Therapeutics.

items.title: At Fierce’s London event, Big Pharmas tell biotechs to ‘be transparent’ to secure deals
items.summary: Every biotech looking for a suitor wants to know: What does it take to charm a Big Pharma into a deal?

items.title: Vertex signs $220M deal with Genomics to re-up long-running discovery pact
items.summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals has re-upped its ties with sequencing specialist Genomics in a deal worth up to $220 million, signing on for an extra four years on top of the eight the companies have already worked together.

items.title: Priavoid’s Alzheimer’s pill fails to prove efficacy in phase 2 trial
items.summary: Priavoid’s pill for Alzheimer's disease has failed to prove its effectiveness in a phase 2 dementia study, although the German biotech pointed to encouraging signs in the longer-term data.

items.title: FDA clears MiniMed Fit tubeless insulin pump
items.summary: MiniMed announced has picked up FDA clearance of its tubeless insulin pump, the MiniMed Fit.

items.title: Cognito phase 3 flops in light-and-sound Alzheimer's trial, but sees ‘signal’ for HOPE
items.summary: Cognito Therapeutics said its phase 3 HOPE study of Spectris AD, an investigational, non-invasive, at-home Alzheimer's therapy that uses light and sound stimulation to engage brain activity, failed to meet its primary endpoint.

items.title: Heidi Overton’s FDA nomination pulled by White House
items.summary: The White House is pulling Heidi Overton’s nomination to lead the FDA just hours before the Senate was scheduled to vote on her confirmation.

items.title: FDA’s complete response letter for Summit’s ivonescimab cites China-heavy data beyond survival miss
items.summary: The FDA’s rejection of Summit Therapeutics’ closely watched PD-1xVEGF bispecific ivonescimab extends beyond its previously reported failure to show a statistically significant overall survival benefit.

items.title: Scientists uncover ‘very detailed map’ of an enzyme target for rare metabolic disease
items.summary: For some rare genetic diseases, the problem isn't a missing protein but the buildup of toxic molecules that the body can no longer clear away.

items.title: Medtronic pays $380M-plus for Contego Medical buyout
items.summary: Medtronic is boosting its cardiovascular disease portfolio with a deal to buy up carotid artery disease and peripheral thrombectomy tech company Contego Medical.

items.title: Kyntra axes mid-stage ADC, adding to years of stumbles
items.summary: Beleaguered Kyntra Bio can’t catch a break. Formerly known as FibroGen, the company has endured a series of woes over the last few years, and now the biotech is cutting a clinical antibody-drug conjugate program from its mid-stage lineup.

items.title: Why 2027 could be ‘Europe’s year to shine’: Panelists debate biotech funding at Fierce’s London event
items.summary: Panelists at Fierce Biotech's London Life Sciences Week event discussed whether Europe can pull its weight in biopharma investment next year against the gravitational pull of the U.S. and China.

items.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B series C months after $2.1B round
items.summary: Isomorphic Labs has raised a $5 billion series C round, marking the second time in six months that the AI drug development startup has pulled off a multibillion-dollar financing.

items.title: AriBio’s oral Alzheimer’s drug meets monotherapy goal in phase 3 as Fosun weighs licensing option
items.summary: AriBio’s erectile dysfunction med-turned Alzheimer’s disease candidate mirodenafil has delivered some mixed results from a global phase 3 trial. Fosun Pharma has an option to in-license the PDE5 inhibitor.

items.title: Sellas marks 9-month survival benefit in late-stage leukemia vaccine study
items.summary: Sellas Life Sciences’ cancer vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia has passed a phase 3 test with a more than nine-month improvement in overall survival.

items.title: Marrow extracts $120M series B to advance preclinical blood disease therapy
items.summary: A new biotech targeting blood disorders, aptly called Marrow Therapeutics, has launched with $173 million in combined funding and a preclinical lead program aimed at sickle cell disease and beta thalassemia.

items.title: Lilly signs $5.9B deal with Stipple to unlock oncology targets
items.summary: Eli Lilly has struck a $5.9 billion deal to partner with Stipple Bio on oncology drug candidates that more precisely target tumor cells.

items.title: CG preps new, expanded bladder cancer plans with FDA after ph. 3 win
items.summary: CG Oncology showed in a late-stage study that its immunotherapy cretostimogene reduced the risk of tumor recurrence in certain patients with non-muscle invasive bladder cancer following surgery.

items.title: Helus' chemically modified psychedelic hits key goals in phase 3 depression trial
items.summary: Helus Pharma's oral chemically modified version of psilocybin hit the key goals of a phase 3 study as an adjunctive treatment in major depressive disorder.

items.title: Biogen inks $411M neurodegeneration pact with protein degrader biotech TrimTech
items.summary: Cambridge, U.K.-based TrimTech Therapeutics has linked up with Biogen in a collaboration worth up to $411 million in biobucks to develop protein degraders for neurodegenerative diseases.

items.title: Lilly secures another myelofibrosis option via $1.5B deal for JPM-founded Calytrix
items.summary: Eli Lilly has added another myelofibrosis prospect to its pipeline courtesy of a $1.5 billion deal for Massachusetts biotech Calytrix Bio.

items.title: BMS' ph. 3 Alzheimer's psychosis teaser builds confidence in Cobenfy expansion plan
items.summary: After delaying the phase 3 readout of its Alzheimer’s psychosis program for Cobenfy earlier this year, Bristol Myers Squibb is offering an early peek that appears to bode well for the high-stakes data drops ahead, even as the fine details remain hazy.

items.title: Beren clinches long-awaited FDA nod for cyclodextrin drug in Niemann-Pick disease
items.summary: Beren Therapeutic's Lembaz was cleared by the FDA to treat the neurogenerative disorder Niemann-Pick disease type C in children as small as 15 pounds. It's the first NPC treatment to improve survival and to treat the cholesterol transport dysfunction that drives the disease.
